title: Pipe Dream
story: In Linux, the pipe operator (`|`) connects the `stdout` of one program directly to the `stdin` of the next, forming an assembly line. Connect the three pipeline stages to generate a secret passphrase, then feed it into `/challenge/interrogator`.
objective:
1. Assembly Line: Connect `/challenge/stage1`, `/challenge/stage2`, and `/challenge/stage3` using pipes (`|`) so `stage3` prints your secret passphrase.
2. The Interrogator: Feed that exact passphrase into `/challenge/interrogator`'s `stdin` using either a pipe (`echo "..." | /challenge/interrogator`) or input redirection (`/challenge/interrogator < file`).
3. Submit the `CYBERUS{...}` flag it prints with `quest submit`.
hints: Feed it into `/challenge/interrogator` with `echo "CYBERUS-PIPE-PASSPHRASE-..." | /challenge/interrogator` (or save it to a file and run `/challenge/interrogator < file`).
